historical_reference.reference_measurement_note: The caret is distinct from the mouse arrow and lies after the transient .a text. No guest search was executed.

gtk2_implementation.recipe_change: Generated GtkEntry styles now set GtkWidget::cursor-aspect-ratio = 0.0, which keeps the insertion stem one pixel wide. Its color still comes from the current view text role; no final RGB is fixed.

gtk_source_basis.entry_cursor_height: gtk/gtkentry.c:5694-5777 derives cursor height from the Entry text-area window and effective inner border.
gtk_source_basis.cursor_stem_and_aspect: gtk/gtkstyle.c:7098-7160 computes stem_width = location.height * cursor_aspect_ratio + 1 and draws the vertical stem; the optional bidi mark is an arrow, not horizontal caps.

validation.method: Real GTK2 GtkEntry rendered offscreen at 338x34; a synthetic GDK focus-in exposes the caret; GTK cursor blinking is disabled only in the probe process to make a stable capture.

test_results.test_gtk2_entry_integration.py: 2 passed; its temporary generation directory now uses ~/tempia

limits: At the 338x34 matching outer size, GTK2's font-derived stem is 18px tall, versus the measured 14px VUE stem; the recipe font is 13px and font choice was outside this focused correction.
GTK2's themed insertion-cursor painter does not draw the VUE horizontal end caps. Matching them would require a custom GTK2 painter or toolkit-level code, outside this theme recipe.
Focus delivery was synthetic in the offscreen probe. A real mapped X focus cycle remains pending.
Caret blink period was read from GTK settings (1200ms) but not measured against SR10.4; caret blinking was disabled only inside the probe process.
No theme was installed or applied to XChat; no user-session settings changed.
